data.title: 菲伦 · 城镇甜品店·巨型圣代与鼓鼓腮帮
data.description: 【菲伦 · 城镇甜品店·巨型圣代与满足腮帮】装潢温馨的城镇甜品屋里，菲伦坐在桌前，双手捧着比脸还大的巨型草莓冰淇淋圣代。她鼓起塞得满满的腮帮子幸福地眯起眼睛，头顶仿佛冒出了小花——「这家店的奶油甜度非常完美……芙莉莲大人要是再赖床的话，我就要把属于她的那份也全部吃掉了。」
data.promptProse: At the village dessert shop, Fern steadies an oversized strawberry sundae glass on the table with both hands. She has just taken one bite: her cheeks remain slightly puffed and her eyes narrow in contentment. The long silver spoon rests on the saucer beside the glass, leaving her hands free to support it. A soft cardigan layers over her blouse and long pleated skirt, and her purple hair is tied half up. Warm pendant light mixes with afternoon window light on the berries and glass. Frame the seated figure, both hands and the whole sundae without lettering.
